vertices.description: A list of vertices that should be fused together into a single group.

runtimes.description: A list of runtimes that all vertices in this group can execute in.

hardwareConstraints.description:
A list of hardware constraints for _each_ of the vertices in this group. Use {@link HardwareConstraint#max} to
find the best available hardware constraint that can support the execution of all vertices in this group.

title: This type represents a possible {@link Workflow} fusion group for the {@link Workflow.VertexFusion} optimization.
name: Workflow.VertexFusion.FusionGroup
